crossRefs.note: Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate. When any man had a suit which should come to the king for…
When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live…
Hushai said to Absalom, “The counsel that Ahithophel has given this time is not good.”
Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, “Should I go against…
The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “See now, the prophets declare good to the king with one…
“Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

translations.web: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.
translations.bsb: If one blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be counted to him as a curse.
translations.kjv: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse
translations.asv: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, It shall be counted a curse to him.
